infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DineOpen uses your camera to scan QR codes for table orders, capture menu item photos, and scan supplier invoices for inventory management.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DineOpen accesses your photo library to upload menu item images, restaurant logos, and supplier invoice photos for inventory tracking.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DineOpen uses the microphone for voice-based order taking, allowing staff to speak orders instead of typing them.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: DineOpen uses speech recognition to convert spoken orders into text for faster order entry.
